AND shop_id = ?\"\n      )\n      .get(campaignId, settlementId, shopId) as\n      | {\n          name: string;\n          stock: string;\n          buy_price: number;\n          sell_price: number;\n        }\n      | undefined;\n    if (!shopRow) {\n      database.exec(\"ROLLBACK;\");\n      return \"not_found\";\n    }\n\n    const memberRow = database\n      .prepare(\n        \"SELECT gold FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ?
